common_style: Extremely simple rounded 2D game mascot matching Approved/Goyeongi/v2/master.png. Compact single rounded body, tiny solid dot eyes, small simple mouth, few broad markings, smooth, continuous single dark outline with even stroke weight. Limited light neutral or muted pastel color fields. No cheek blush, separate decorative belly patch, fur texture, fingers or toe lines. Keep details readable at small size. Actual approved artwork is the visual authority. Preserve subtle light/shadow tone differences and species-specific accent colors, matching Goyeongi v2. Simple shape does not mean monochrome. Do not flatten all characters to 2-4 colors. Small subtle white catchlights in the dot eyes and short soft eyebrows are now requested. Keep them tiny and simple. Add two tiny short rounded arms without fingers. All characters must have NO TAIL. Use large head / tiny rounded body / very short limbs. Proportion and future movement reference: Chiikawa-like short steps, small arm swings and light body bounces; preserve our original character designs.

goyeongi_exact_positive: Minimalist bold vector game icon. A very short wide light-grey bean creature with two tiny pointed ears on top and a little curved tail, and two tiny round feet. The entire character is a single horizontal oval, twice as wide as it is tall. Two small round black dots and a tiny horizontal black dash form the entire face. There are three short charcoal stripes on its forehead and two stripes on the tail. Uniform extra thick black outline around every shape. Flat light-grey fill. Flat charcoal markings. Pure white background. Very simple iconic silhouette, clean crisp graphic shapes, no shading, no highlights, no texture, no other facial details. The character resembles a tiny minimalist cat from a casual mobile action game.
